title: [CI] Fold report tools into main build and publish packaged apps in one MSBuild call

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The accumulated assessment found no remaining actionable defect in the report-tool consolidation and aggregate packaging change. The reported concerns were addressed, contradicted by the current source/callers, or optional improvements. No supported design-level flaw remains.

**Validation scope:** Eight focused solution/parser and aggregate-publish checks passed across the Debug/Release and x64/ARM64 mappings. The aggregate task checks used fixture child projects, not the real applications. Actual report-tool compilation, real application publishing, and full ARM64 CI are not certified by those checks.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified review summary, not an unconditional approval.

actions.label: Post qualified assessment summary (no code changes requested)
